You can file a standard appeal by submitting it in writing or by calling Clover Health using the contact information in Chapter 2 of the Evidence of Coverage. [1]
You can file a fast appeal by submitting it in writing or by calling Clover Health using the contact information in Chapter 2 of the Evidence of Coverage. [1]
You must make your appeal request within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice sent by Clover Health about the coverage decision. [1]
If you miss the 65-day deadline for filing an appeal, you can explain the reason for the delay, and Clover Health may grant you more time. [1]
You can ask for a copy of the information regarding your medical decision and add more information to support your appeal. [1]

You can get care from out-of-network providers, but your share of the costs may be higher. [1]
Out-of-network providers are not obligated to treat you unless it is an emergency. [1]
If you use an out-of-network provider who is not eligible to participate in Medicare, you will be responsible for the full cost of services. [1]
You do not need a referral or prior authorization to see out-of-network providers. [1]
If you get emergency care, urgently needed services, or out-of-area dialysis from an out-of-network provider, you may not have to pay a higher cost-sharing amount. [1]
If you pay for covered services from an out-of-network provider, you can ask the plan to reimburse you for its share of the cost. [1]
